SELECT CAPP.PURPOSE_ID, CAPP.PRODUCT_ID, CAPP.CONTRACT_ID, CAPP.CON_DOCUMENT_CATEGORY, CAPP.PURPOSE_TYPE, V1.MEANING PURPOSE_TYPE_N, CAPP.ABS_COMPANY_ID, V2.MEANING ABS_COMPANY_ID_N, CAPP.PURPOSE_AMOUNT, CAPP.DESCRIPTION, CON.CONTRACT_NAME PURPOSE_DOC_NAME, CON.CONTRACT_NUMBER PURPOSE_DOC_NUMBER, CON.CONTRACT_NUMBER PURPOSE_DOC_NUMBER_N, CON.SAL_BP_NAME, CON.BUY_BP_NAME FROM CT_ABS_PRODUCT_PURPOSE CAPP LEFT JOIN ( SELECT CC.CONTRACT_ID, CC.CONTRACT_NAME, CC.CONTRACT_NUMBER, ( SELECT MAX( BM.BP_NAME ) FROM PRJ_PROJECT_BP PB JOIN HLS_BP_MASTER BM ON PB.BP_ID = BM.BP_ID WHERE PB.BP_CATEGROY = 'CON_CONTRACT' AND PB.BP_TYPE = 'TENANT' AND PB.PROJECT_ID = CC.PROJECT_ID ) SAL_BP_NAME, ( SELECT MAX( BM.BP_NAME ) FROM PRJ_PROJECT_BP PB JOIN HLS_BP_MASTER BM ON PB.BP_ID = BM.BP_ID WHERE PB.BP_CATEGROY = 'CON_CONTRACT' AND PB.BP_TYPE = 'TENANT_SEC' AND PB.PROJECT_ID = CC.PROJECT_ID ) BUY_BP_NAME, 'CON_CONTRACT' CON_DOCUMENT_CATEGORY FROM CON_CONTRACT CC WHERE CC.DATA_CLASS = 'NORMAL'
UNION
SELECT FC.CONTRACT_ID, FC.CONTRACT_NAME, FC.CONTRACT_NUMBER, ( SELECT MAX( HBM.BP_NAME ) FROM FCT_PROJECT_BP FPB JOIN HLS_BP_MASTER HBM ON HBM.BP_ID = FPB.BP_ID WHERE FPB.BP_ROLE_TYPE = 'SELLER' AND FPB.PROJECT_ID = FP.PROJECT_ID ) SAL_BP_NAME, ( SELECT MAX( HBM.BP_NAME ) FROM FCT_PROJECT_BP FPB JOIN HLS_BP_MASTER HBM ON HBM.BP_ID = FPB.BP_ID WHERE FPB.BP_ROLE_TYPE = 'BUYER' AND FPB.PROJECT_ID = FP.PROJECT_ID ) BUY_BP_NAME, 'FCT_CONTRACT' CON_DOCUMENT_CATEGORY FROM FCT_CONTRACT FC JOIN FCT_PROJECT FP ON FC.PROJECT_ID = FP.PROJECT_ID WHERE FC.DATA_CLASS = 'NORMAL'
UNION
SELECT CC.CONTRACT_ID, CC.CONTRACT_NAME, CC.CONTRACT_NUMBER, NULL SAL_BP_NAME, NULL BUY_BP_NAME, 'LON_CONTRACT' CON_DOCUMENT_CATEGORY FROM LON_CONTRACT CC ) CON ON CON.CONTRACT_ID = CAPP.CONTRACT_ID -- AND CON.CON_DOCUMENT_CATEGORY = CAPP.CON_DOCUMENT_CATEGORY LEFT JOIN sys_code_value_b_v v1 ON v1.CODE = 'PURPOSE_TYPE' AND v1.code_value = CAPP.PURPOSE_TYPE LEFT JOIN sys_code_value_b_v v2 ON v2.CODE = 'ABS_COMPANY_ID' AND v2.code_value = CAPP.ABS_COMPANY_ID
AND CAPP.PRODUCT_ID = #{productId}
